items.headline: Warriors-Clippers Preseason Game Postponed Amid Salary Cap Scandal Investigation
items.summary: The NBA has postponed the October 5th preseason game between the Golden State Warriors and the Los Angeles Clippers, citing a rule violation involving a key Warriors star. This decision comes amidst a broader investigation into allegations that the LA Clippers and Kawhi Leonard used a fraudulent company to funnel $28 million in a 'no-show job' endorsement, potentially violating NBA salary-cap rules. The league is considering voiding Leonard's contract, which could trigger a massive free agency bidding war.

items.headline: Jazz Edge Nuggets in Preseason Opener
items.summary: The Utah Jazz defeated the Denver Nuggets 109-97 in their preseason opener. Nikola Jokic, despite the loss, delivered a highlight-reel no-look, behind-the-back assist in 14 minutes of play.

items.headline: Hachimura Shines as Clippers Beat Warriors
items.summary: Rui Hachimura led the way for the Los Angeles Clippers with 21 points in their 104-101 preseason victory over the Golden State Warriors. This was Hachimura's first game in a Clippers jersey.

items.headline: Lakers vs. Kings
items.summary: The Los Angeles Lakers travel to Sacramento to face the Kings at the Golden 1 Center.

items.headline: Suns vs. Pistons
items.summary: The Phoenix Suns take on the Detroit Pistons at Little Caesars Arena. Phoenix will look to rebound from last season's first-round sweep, while Detroit aims to maintain its strong form after a 60-win season.

items.headline: Knicks vs. 76ers
items.summary: The New York Knicks, last season's Eastern Conference champions, begin their preseason campaign against a Philadelphia 76ers squad that now features LeBron James and Jaylen Brown. Expect a light workload for Knicks starters.

items.headline: Milwaukee Bucks in Preseason Action
items.summary: The Milwaukee Bucks are also scheduled for a preseason game tonight.

items.headline: Atlanta Hawks Preseason Matchup
items.summary: The Atlanta Hawks are set to play a preseason game this evening.

items.headline: Jokic Delivers 'Assist of the Year' Candidate Early in Preseason
items.summary: Denver Nuggets center Nikola Jokic showcased his incredible passing vision in a preseason game against the Utah Jazz, dishing out a no-look, behind-the-back dime for a three-pointer.

items.headline: Rui Hachimura Impresses in Clippers Debut
items.summary: New Clipper Rui Hachimura made a strong first impression, leading his team with 21 points in their preseason victory over the Warriors.

items.headline: Suns' Mark Williams Out with Shoulder Injury
items.summary: Phoenix Suns big man Mark Williams is sidelined with a shoulder injury after undergoing surgery to repair a torn labrum in his left shoulder, impacting the team's frontcourt rotation early in the preseason.

items.headline: Knicks Starters to See Light Preseason Workload
items.summary: New York Knicks coach Mike Brown plans to give his starters a limited workload throughout the preseason, allowing reserves and veterans fighting for roster spots to showcase their skills.
